summary.text: Pediatric patient with a Dubberley type 2A capitellum fracture operatively treated within one week of the initial trauma by open reduction through a lateral approach and fixation with two headless Herbert screws, followed by four weeks of casting and physiotherapy.

Stitches were removed at 15 days with painless range of motion; at the end of follow-up the fracture had healed without malunion, pseudarthrosis, osteonecrosis, neurovascular injury or infection, and the patient returned to pre-injury daily activity.

summary.text: Pediatric patient with a Dubberley type 2A capitellum fracture operatively treated within one week of the initial trauma by open reduction through a lateral approach and fixation with two headless Herbert screws, followed by four weeks of casting and physiotherapy.
